title: Phase 2：反例搜尋器第六批（只驗到小範圍的條目）：推翻 A372430 的猜想（2^87 + 2^49）

A372430.proof: k = 2^87 + 2^49 has binary indices {50, 88}; prime(50) = 229 and prime(88) = 457 divide k (2^38+1 = 5*229*457*525313). Lean a372430_counterexample. Least after 4100: exhaustive DFS over k < 2^120.

A219433.proof: no new exception for n <= 1e8 (only the known n = 522720)

novelty.note: Counterexample not found anywhere on OEIS; it is far beyond the stated 10^7 check, found by a structured exhaustive search. Elementary once found. Web, MathSciNet, zbMATH not searched.
